errors.text_span: The chart is divided into a total of ten slices, representing different categories.
errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate pie charts, not one pie chart with ten slices. The three charts are: 'Categorical' (4 slices), 'Approximate Number Generation' (3 slices), and 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive' (2 slices), totaling 9 slices across three charts.

In the Categorical pie chart, the Limiter slice is pink, Negation is orange, and there is no standalone 'Quantifiers' slice at 27.91%. The labels shown are Existential Quantifiers (15.12%), Limiter (27.91%), Universal Quantifiers (29.07%), and Negation (27.91%).

These are not two separate slices. 'Absolute Absence' is a single slice (purple/lavender) representing 18.71% in the Approximate Number Generation chart. The description wrongly splits it into two slices.
The third chart shows two separate slices: Disjunctive (49.51%, lavender/light blue) and Conjunctive (50.49%, pink). These are two distinct slices, not one combined slice.
The description fails to mention that there are three separate pie charts (Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive), each with its own title and purpose.
The description does not mention the Disjunctive slice (49.51%) in the third chart, which is a distinct category shown in the figure.
